description: This file contains comprehensive tests for Slack native streaming feature functions such as enabling streaming, thread hint resolution, preview streaming eligibility, and draft stream initialization. It uses the Vitest framework to verify correct behavior under various conditions.

methods.name: isSlackStreamingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if Slack streaming is enabled based on the message mode and native streaming flag.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamingThreadHint
methods.description: Resolves the thread hint for Slack streaming based on reply mode, incoming thread timestamp, and message timestamp.

methods.name: shouldEnableSlackPreviewStreaming
methods.description: Decides whether to enable Slack preview streaming based on message context such as mode, direct message status, and thread information.

methods.name: shouldInitializeSlackDraftStream
methods.description: Determines if the Slack draft stream should be initialized, based on preview streaming enablement and streaming mode.
